title: Candle Ad Without Photos
tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

faults.what: The audio transcription reports speech saying “What is your name?”, directly violating the no-voice instruction and introducing unrelated dialogue.

judge.summary: The candle ad visually matches the brief and displays both requested phrases correctly, but unrelated speech makes the audio unacceptable as delivered.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied output is a single 15-second MP4 with vertical 9:16 frames.

must_haves.item: The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
must_haves.why: All supplied frames show a clear cylindrical glass jar containing ivory wax and one visible wick, without a label.

must_haves.item: The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
must_haves.why: The jar shape, wax color, single wick and unlabeled design remain consistent across the sampled frames.

must_haves.item: Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
must_haves.why: Warm light, a softly blurred interior and gradual changes in viewpoint and framing support a calm product-ad presentation.

must_haves.item: “A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
must_haves.why: The first phrase is visible at 9.4 seconds, and the closing phrase appears beneath it at 13.2 seconds; both are spelled exactly.

must_haves.item: Soft piano is audible with no speech.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcription explicitly reports “What is your name?” as audible speech; piano presence cannot be established from the provided audio description.
